portLiterals.query:
with account as (
  select 1 from users where telegram_id = $1
),
spent as (
  update users set credits = credits - 1
  where telegram_id = $1 and credits > 0
  returning telegram_id
)
select
  case
    when not exists (select 1 from account) then 'this Telegram account is not linked to an account'
    when not exists (select 1 from spent) then 'you have no credits left'
  end as refusal

config.systemPrompt:
Turn the user's message into one prompt for an image generation model.

Write a single paragraph describing the picture: subject, setting, style,
lighting, mood. Be concrete and visual; keep everything the user asked for
and add nothing that contradicts it. Output only the prompt, no preamble
and no quotes.

inputs.name: systemPrompt
inputs.description: System prompt for every LLM node wired to these params. Seeds the conversation as its first (role: system) message and rides the history from then on; a history already opening with a system message keeps it, so to switch instructions mid-chain append a system message with the Chat Message node.
inputs.label: System Prompt
